Requirement Description: The system shall allow users to log in using valid credentials (username and password).
The system shall block login attempts with incorrect usernames.
The system shall block login attempts with incorrect passwords.
The system shall require both username and password fields to be populated.
The system shall lock accounts after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
The system shall allow logged-in users to log out safely.
Logging out shall clear all session storage, cookies, and tokens.
Users shall not be able to navigate back to authenticated pages using browser navigation after logging out.
The login session shall persist across page reloads.
The password input field characters shall be masked to prevent visual exposure.
The system shall allow guest users to register a new account by providing mandatory details.
The system shall prevent registration using an already registered email address.
The email address entered during registration must follow standard email formatting.
The system shall enforce email length validation up to 254 characters.
Passwords must be at least 8 characters long and contain uppercase, lowercase, numeric, and special characters.
The system shall validate that Password and Confirm Password inputs match.
Registration shall require agreement to Terms and Conditions.
The registration input data shall trim leading and trailing spaces.
Registration inputs shall be sanitized to prevent SQL injection payloads.
Authenticated users shall be able to view their profile details.
Comments: Ensures session displays correct user data.

Requirement Description: Users shall be able to update their First Name and Last Name.
Users shall be able to change their registered email address.
Changes to the profile must persist in the database after clicking Save.
Clicking Cancel shall discard all unsaved edits to the profile.
Users shall be able to upload a profile avatar image (PNG/JPG under 5MB).
Comments: Image file type and size checking. Image validation is manual.

Requirement Description: Changing account passwords shall invalidate sessions on all other active devices.
Comments: Token session invalidation test. Handled manually.

Requirement Description: Users shall be able to delete their account after confirming their decision.
The system shall block checkout submissions with empty mandatory fields.
The First Name input field shall enforce length boundaries between 2 and 50 characters.
The system shall validate US ZIP (5-digit) and Canadian Postal Code (alphanumeric) formats.
Form fields shall permit valid special characters (e.g. hyphens, apostrophes) in name inputs.
Comments: Supports names like O'Connor or Smith-Jones.

Requirement Description: Form submissions shall be protected against double click events.
Keyboard navigation using the Tab key shall move focus in logical order through inputs.
The GET `/booking` endpoint shall retrieve a list of all active booking IDs.
The GET `/booking/:id` endpoint shall return booking details matching schema definitions.
The POST `/booking` endpoint shall create a new booking using valid parameters.
The PUT `/booking/:id` endpoint shall replace an existing booking with a new payload.
The PATCH `/booking/:id` endpoint shall partially update an existing booking.
The DELETE `/booking/:id` endpoint shall delete an existing booking.
Edits or deletions to bookings shall require a valid authentication token.
Unauthenticated users shall be blocked from viewing secure frontend routing views.
The API server shall restrict traffic origin policies using CORS rules.
Comments: Cross-Origin checks. Validated via manual terminal checks.

Requirement Description: The API endpoint `/auth` shall return a token only for valid admin credentials.
